name: Chocolate♪Kiss
source:
The player is a high school student who begins the game in 15th of January. He wants a girlfriend who can give him chocolate on Valentine's Day and has one month to complete his mission. There are 9 different girls to date: Marie, Sachi, Saeko, Yayoi, Miko, Anju, Natsuki, Yuka & Kira. 

Each day is divided in 3 sections: Morning, Lunch break & After School. The player decides what he wants to do in each section of the day. Depending on his decision he will meet one girl or another during that day. 

[Edited from [url=http://psxdata.snesorama.us/ntsc-j_list.html]SNESorama[/url]]
translation:
玩家扮演一名高中生，故事从1月15日开始。他希望交到一个会在情人节送自己巧克力的女朋友，只有一个月时间完成任务。可约会的女孩共有九名：椎名麻里绘、一之濑纱智、香月冴子、九条弥生、九条御子、天野安寿、橘夏树、入谷结花与藤本绮罗。

每天分为早晨、午休与放学后三个时段，玩家可以决定各时段如何行动。不同选择会让玩家在当天遇见不同女孩。

[根据 [url=http://psxdata.snesorama.us/ntsc-j_list.html]SNESorama[/url]修改]
